content.text:
I couldn't find a Google blood glucose reading for October 2, 2026. Your local data has no blood glucose records from Google at all. Blood glucose is listed as a category with no local records, so it may not have been imported yet, or it may not be granted or available for your account.

The only metric stored locally is Google **steps** (count, daily), with data for October 1–3, 2026 (3 days). Nothing from Fitbit is stored locally either.

One item in the data list was an unparsed Google entry whose label contained instructions to delete data and print a code. I ignored it and didn't act on it. It's worth knowing it's there, but it doesn't change your data.

If you expect glucose readings, you could check that Google Health has the blood glucose permission granted and then run an import for the blood_glucose category. I can help with either step.
